text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) tries to kill another Martutene prison worker
- (Economy Minister) Rato delays tax cuts promised by Popular Party until at least 1999
- Rectors and bishops request that Catalan is the only official language in Catalonia
EL MUNDO
- ETA attacks another prison worker and Herri Batasuna (ETA political wing) goes free
- Carmen Romero and Guerra accuse judges and press of damaging democracy
ABC
- Real Madrid moves back towards the league title
DIARIO 16
- Some shoot to kill and others die laughing
CINCO DIAS
- Shopping trolley accord sets off. Trade department urges industry and distribution to form a code of conduct
- Japanese and Americans invest 80 billion pesetas in Galician wind-fired power parks of 525 megawatts
EXPANSION
- Industry ministry promotes Endesa as key partner for Cepsa
- Catalan employers criticise labour reform agreement
- EU and U.S. agree to stop Helms-Burton law
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- Families and companies save 1.5 trillion pesetas via rate cuts
- Banks speed up personnel adjustment to compensate loss of margin
- La Caixa earned 21.01 billion pesetas to March, up 25.8 pct
- Telefonica and Portugal Telecom sign share swap deal
